# LivelyLightingCo

> LivelyLightingCo installs permanent outdoor LED lighting across Texas and Oklahoma. The systems are low-profile, use hidden wiring, are controlled from a phone app, and are used year-round for everyday warm white, holidays, game days, and architectural accent lighting.

## Key facts

- Service: Professional installation of permanent outdoor LED lighting (roofline lighting).
- Brands installed: Govee Pro, Govee Prism, Asahom, Eufy, and Enbrighten. LivelyLightingCo is a certified installer, including Govee-certified installation.
- Mounting: PermTrack track, made of rigid, UV-resistant PVC (the same material family as vinyl window frames), color-matched to the home, with hidden wiring.
- Warranty: Lifetime warranty on the PermTrack mounting hardware plus a 5-year workmanship warranty. LEDs carry their brand manufacturer warranty.
- Control: Smartphone app — millions of colors, scenes, scheduling, and music sync. Year-round use.
- Service area: All of Texas and all of Oklahoma. Headquarters: Cedar Park, TX (Austin metro). Actively expanding across Oklahoma.
- Typical cost: about $18–$35 per linear foot of roofline; most homes $2,000–$8,000+ depending on size, roof complexity, brand, and number of stories.
- Best-price guarantee: will beat any written quote from Trimlight, Jellyfish, Oelo, or Gemstone (Astoria).
- Contact: phone (737) 423-7246, email installs@livelylightingco.com.

## Cities served

Texas: Austin, Cedar Park, Leander, Round Rock, Georgetown, Pflugerville, Dallas, Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio. Oklahoma: Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Norman, Edmond, Broken Arrow.
